args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring already claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212, but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN
so 2.665 rounds to 2.66 as expected.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even-FIN-212
args.title: Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring claimed `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Changes
- Switched `round_money` in `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
